facts.fact: BFA Asset Management, the Luanda-based asset-management spin-off of Banco de Fomento Angola, invested $1.2 million from its Kimbo Fund in Anda, an Angolan motorcycle-taxi mobility start-up, announced in March 2026 (TechCabal interview).
The $1.2 million put into Anda came from BFA Asset Management of Luanda, an Angolan firm spun off from Banco de Fomento Angola, so the financier is from Angola itself; announced March 2026.

Anda has raised $3.4 million in total from Breega, Speedinvest and 4DX Ventures, venture investors from outside Angola by their names; the article gives no date for the rounds, so its published date is used.

note: FSDEA's $5 million to the Kimbo Fund (2024) is a sovereign wealth fund's money and FoodCare is not a digital business, so neither is a fact.
